units.source_text: 青年女子要从今隔绝红尘而闭居在这荒寂的山乡中，是难能之事。

en.t: For a young woman to cut herself off from the world from now on and shut herself away in this desolate mountain village was no easy thing.

units.source_text: 因此常住在这里的，只有七八个年纪很大的老尼姑。

en.t: Thus the only people who lived here permanently were seven or eight very old nuns.

units.source_text: 她们的女儿及孙辈，有在京都宫中服役的，有住在别处的，常常到这里来访问。

en.t: Their daughters and grandchildren, some serving in the imperial palace in Kyoto and some living elsewhere, often came here to visit.

units.source_text: 浮舟担心：“这些来客之中，倘有人出入于和我有关的人家，则我尚在世间的消息，自会传入什么人的耳中，这便使我羞死了。

en.t: Ukifune worried: “If, among these visitors, someone should go in and out of a household connected with me, then word that I am still alive would surely reach someone, and I would die of shame.

units.source_text: 他们将推想我做了何等不端之事，以致沦落在此，便会把我看作世间少有的下流女子。”

en.t: They would imagine I had done something terribly improper to have fallen so low as to end up here, and would regard me as a woman of rare baseness in this world.”

units.source_text: 因此她绝不和这些来客见面。

en.t: For that reason she absolutely refused to meet any of these visitors.

units.source_text: 只有妹尼僧自己身边的两个侍女，一个也叫作侍从，一个叫作可莫姬的，派在浮舟房中服侍。

en.t: Only two attendants from the younger nun's own side, one also called Jijū and one called Kamo no Kimi, were assigned to serve in Ukifune's room.

units.source_text: 这两个人的容貌与性情，自然比不上她从前所见的京都女子。

en.t: In looks and temperament, these two naturally could not compare with the Kyoto women she had seen before.

units.source_text: 因此每有所感，总想起她从前咏的诗句“但得远离浮世苦”，恍悟这里便是远离浮世的地方。

en.t: So whenever something moved her, she always remembered the verse she had once composed, “If only I could leave the pains of the floating world behind,” and suddenly realized that this was the very place apart from that world.

units.source_text: 浮舟一直悄悄地躲在这里。

en.t: Ukifune went on hiding here quietly all the while.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧也恐防这个人被人知道了真会发生事端，故对这里所有的人都不详细说明。

en.t: The younger nun also feared that if this person became known, real trouble would arise, and so she gave no detailed explanation to anyone there.
